questions.prompt: Approved grant-protected paths for this repository
questions.preamble: Grant-protected paths are repository paths no autonomy grant may merge a change to, added to Orch's built-in floor. They come from an Architect survey (survey methodology version 1) that you approve here and again when the PR merges.

options.label: Keep current
options.description: Leave the committed protected list unchanged.

options.label: No protected paths
options.description: Approve an empty list beyond the built-in floor.

questions.hint: Answer "defer", "[]" (approve an empty list), or a JSON array like [{"path":"internal/auth","reason":"session and token handling"}]: each path repository-relative, each reason one line.
